name: Inbaku no Kanenone
source:
I received a letter from my childhood friend.
She was a resident maid of the Shichijo estate.

"The roads will be closed during the off-season,
what do you say to coming and working here for a while?"

I agreed to at least visit the place, but what I saw...
my childhood friend Kimi whipped and beaten by head servant Murata...
her body twisted into contortions of painful joy...

Candle wax and whips.
Bondage, medieval wedging, suspension by nipples,
electrocution, facer*pe, enema creampies, anal fisting...

Led by their bewitching mistress Ayako,
each night the women of the estate host a banquet of obscenity,
repetitions of the flesh upon the sound of the bell.

translation:
我收到了我儿时好友的来信。
她是七条家的常驻女仆。

“淡季期间道路将关闭，
你觉得来这里工作一段时间怎么样？”

我同意至少去参观一下这个地方，但我所看到的……
我的青梅竹马基美被仆人村田鞭打……
她的身体因痛苦的喜悦而扭曲着……

蜡烛蜡和鞭子。
束缚、中世纪的楔入、乳头悬吊、
触电、facer*pe、灌肠creampies、肛门拳交…

在迷人的情妇绫子的带领下，
庄园里的妇女们每天晚上都会举办一场淫秽的宴会，
肉体随着钟声的重复。
